bound_definition: For every exact original 13-field feature vector, choose the most frequent candidate label. Sum those per-vector maxima. This is a label-informed in-sample oracle bound for any deterministic mapping of the frozen inputs, not achievable holdout performance.
explanations: Exact feature duplicates with opposing labels guarantee at least one in-sample mistake per conflicting group for any deterministic predictor on those exact inputs.

The label-majority oracle uses the true candidate labels while constructing its predictions; this is information leakage if used as a practical prediction method and therefore cannot be reported as achieved test accuracy.
A deterministic multinomial softmax has additional functional restrictions. The observed 60/64 oracle bound is only an optimistic upper bound, not a claim this particular model can attain it.
All 10 opposing-label candidate records belong to lineage L002, which the original RB2 fold map assigns to outer test fold 0. Candidate coverage is incomplete in L005/L006/L010.
The original R5 independent review ledger has no external attestation; candidate labels can change or be rejected after full-text review, changing any later bounds.
Fold 0 diagnostic test subset contains L004 and L002 candidates but no eligible L005 comparisons. Its 23/27 oracle is NOT a valid reported cross-validation result.
A NULL outcome means author-attributed statistical nonsignificance, not a demonstrated zero effect or formal equivalence.
Known model-feature gaps include exact gene/cell marker, morphology subtype, and post-exposure assay readout delay. R5-E5 does not change the frozen feature set.
